faqs.q: Can I upload my own fonts?
faqs.a: Yes. Add your own fonts and choose which ones shoppers can use.

faqs.q: Can I organize clipart into categories?
faqs.a: Yes. Group clipart into categories so shoppers can browse it easily.

faqs.q: Can different products show different assets?
faqs.a: Yes. You control which fonts and clipart are available for each product or printing method.

faqs.q: Can I set a default font?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the default font the design tool uses when shoppers add custom text.
